newsitem.title: USA: CME traders call USDA data bullish for CME bellies.
newsitem.headline: CME traders call USDA data bullish for CME bellies.

text.p: CME livestock traders and analysts called USDA's monthly cold storage report bullish for CME pork belly futures, and said it may prompt a 0.50 to 1.00 cent per lb higher opening Monday.
USDA reported June 30 frozen pork belly stocks at 52.318 million lbs, which was less than analysts' estimates that ranged from 53.5 million to 53.8 million lbs.

"Right now I would call the bellies another 100 (1.00 cent) higher on Monday," said Dale Benson, livestock analyst with Dean Witter. "We are also hearing a firmer tone to the cash belly market next week, probably up to 94 cents (per lb) Tuesday."
